children: shares moved higher Monday after the companies, alongside Corning

, revealed plans to demonstrate a high-density optical interconnect platform designed for next-generation AI infrastructure. The technology aims to improve data transfer between chips while reducing power consumption in large-scale AI systems.

In premarket trading, Corning gained about 3%, Lumentum climbed 2%, and Qualcomm added 1.5%. The announcement comes as investors continue to focus on optical networking technologies that are increasingly viewed as a critical part of the AI infrastructure buildout.

The demonstration will combine Qualcomm's chip-to-chip interface technology, Lumentum's VCSEL-based optical platform, and Corning's fiber connectivity products. The companies said the architecture is intended to support future AI computing systems that require greater bandwidth and lower latency.

title: AI Networking Bet Sends Qualcomm, Lumentum Shares Higher
